svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 731 mm lengths of 20 x 20 x 1.5 mm square tube; deburr

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (743 mm overall with the latch body on the end).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 6.5 mm across, 10 mm from one end: the pivot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rivet the over-centre latch body to the other end, hook outward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot bracket: 3 mm aluminium angle, ear 35 mm tall beside the bar,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: riveted to the top corner of the left wing's frame, on its back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keeper: screwed to the top of the right wing's outer member,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm in from its back face, opposite the latch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Travel: the bar lies across the tops of both stowed wings and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: latch pulls the right wing in against it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Parked: the bar folds down the back of the left wing, held by a clip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: latched, neither wing moves when pushed outward at the top.
